spans.s: षडंश n. 1. six parts of the body collectively; (they are- जंघे बाहू शिरो मध्यं षडंगमिदमुच्यते); 2. the six works auxiliary to the Veda; (they are- शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छंदसां चितिः । ज्योतिषामयनं चैव); 3. six things obtained from a cow; (they are- गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं सर्पिर्दीर्घि च रोचना । षडंगमेतन् मांगल्यं पठितं सर्वदा गवाम्).
षडंघ्रि m. a bee, e.g. दारुभेदनिपुणोऽपि षडंघ्रिः.
षडधिक a. exceeded by six, M.M.v.
षडभिज्ञ m. a Buddhist deified saint.
षडशीत a. the eighty-sixth.
षडशीति f. eighty-six.
षडह m. a period of six days.
षडानन m. an epithet of Kārtikeya, षडाननापीतपयोधरासु नेता चमूनामिव कृत्तिकासु R.xiv.22.
षडानन m. an epithet of Kārtikeya, षडाननापीतपयोधरासु नेता चमूनामिव कृत्तिकासु R.xiv.22.
षडानन m. an epithet of Kārtikeya, षडाननापीतपयोधरासु नेता चमूनामिव कृत्तिकासु R.xiv.22.
षडाम्नाय m. the six-fold tantra.
षडूषण n. six spices collectively.
षड्गव n. a yoke of six oxen, (the word is sometimes used after the names of other animals to denote ‘a group of six,’ e.g. अश्वषड्गव ‘six horses’).
षड्गुण (I) a. 1. six-fold; 2. having six qualities.
षड्गुण (II) n. 1. an assemblage of six qualities; 2. the six acts to be practised by a king in foreign politics. (See under गुण.)
षड्ग्रंथिका f. zedoary.
षड्ज m. the first of the seven primary notes in music; [it is thus derived- नासां कठमुरस्तालु जिह्वादंताश्च संस्पृशन् । षड्भ्यः संजायते यस्मात् तस्मात् षड्ज
इति स्मृतः
] षड्जसंवादिनीः केका द्विधा भिन्नाः शिखंडिभिः R.i.39.
षड्दर्शन n. the six systems of philosophy taken together; (they are- न्याय, वैशेषिक, सांख्य, योग, मीमांसा and वेदांत).
षड्दुर्ग n. six kinds of forts taken together; [the six kinds are- (1) धन्वदुर्ग, (2) महीदुर्ग, (3) गिरिदुर्ग, (4) मनुष्यदुर्ग, (5) मृद्दुर्ग and (6) वनदुर्ग].
षड्धा ind. in six ways. (Cf. षोढा.)
षड्बिंदु m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
षड्भाग m. a sixth part, a sixth, M.vii.131.
षड्भुजा f. 1. an epithet of Durgā; 2. the water-melon.
षड्रस n. the six flavours collectively, (मधुरो लवणस्तिक्तः कषायोऽम्लः कटुस्तथा).
षड्रात्र n. a period of six nights.
षड्वर्ग m. 1. an aggregate of six things; 2. the six enemies of humanity taken together; [for their enumeration, See अरि (3)], व्यजेष्ट षड्वर्गमरंस्त नीतौ Bt.i.2, Kir.i.9.
षड्विंशति f. twenty-six.
षड्विध a. six fold, of six sorts, R.iv.26.
षाडव m. 1. Passion, sentiment; 2. music, singing; 3. a Rāga in which six of the seven primary notes are used (in music).
षाड्गुण्य n. 1. Six measures of royal policy, (See गुण and षड्गुण), M.vii.58; 2. an aggregate of six qualities; 3. multiplication of any thing by six.
षाड्गुण्य-प्रयोग m. the application of the six measures of royal policy.
